annotation.description:
shots from what appear to be a business get together.
In the frist scene, 2 people get food from a series of heated metal containers.
then a white and black man with badges can be seen smiling with phones in their hand.
New we see a close up shot of a tree and leaves.
The last shot shows a stage with 2 persons on it, while a large crowd is wathcing them.
Many things feel unnatural about the video, especially the smiling of the white and black man.
